aboutText: HealthGuide Bishkek helps international students and newcomers navigate health information. We publish sourced guidance and add directory entries only after human verification.
policyText: Emergency numbers and educational sources are linked throughout the site. Directory entries require a source and verification date; missing facts are marked as unverified. Information can change, so confirm details directly.
whenCallText: Call immediately when someone is seriously ill, injured or in immediate danger. Follow the dispatcher’s instructions.
whatSayText: Give your location, a nearby landmark, what happened, the number of people who need help and a callback number. If you do not speak Russian or Kyrgyz, ask someone nearby to help explain. Contact your university support after calling emergency services.
